card.name: Small words just before a body of water
card.fires_on: Short linking words (to, on, by, in, is, the) that come right before a body of water such as the water, a river, a sea or an ocean. They show up in geography entries and animal-habitat descriptions.

modes.label: Movement toward water
modes.description: Words like to or the after animals travel or are carried toward water.
modes.example: the tadpoles have to find their own way<< to>> the water.

modes.label: Place next to water
modes.description: On, by or is in gazetteer-style descriptions of towns and regions bordering a river, sea or ocean.
modes.example: a residential and industrial suburb of Boston,<< on>> the Mystic River; settled 16

modes.label: Area that is water
modes.description: Words in area statistics that say part of a place is water.

card.writes: It makes the model more likely to output water-related words such as water, waters, lake and river, including in Chinese and Russian.
card.plain: It fires on little words like to or on when the next word is likely to be water, a river or a sea.
